info.title: eigi.ai API
info.description: REST API for managing AI voice agents and conversations

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for authentication. Get your API key from the eigi.ai Dashboard under Settings â†’ API Keys.

mobile_number.description: Phone number involved in the conversation

duration.description: Total duration of the conversation in seconds

agent_id.description: The ID of the AI agent to use for the call

mobile_number.description: Phone number to call in E.164 format

metadata.description: Custom metadata to attach to the conversation

message.example: Hello, how can you help me?

session_id.description: New session ID for the chat

variable_name.description: Canonical key used in prompts and runtime payloads

dynamic_variables.description: Normalized dynamic variable definitions configured for the agent

ToolsConfig.description: Configure agent tools. Each tool can be true (enable), false (disable), or an object with configuration.

end_call.description: End call tool - enabled by default. Use true/false to toggle.

transfer_call.description: Transfer call tool. When using config object, requires transfer_phone_number.

schedule_call.description: Schedule call tool. Optional allow_immediate config.

set_language.description: Set language tool. Optional language_string config.

background_audio.description: Background audio tool with audio file and volume config.

user_idle.description: User idle detection with timeout and retry config.

agent_mobile_number.description: Mobile numbers associated with the agent

call_analysis_prompt.description: Optional call analysis prompt reference. Provide custom_prompt to create a new analysis prompt version before linking it to the agent.

call_analysis_schema.description: Optional schema for structured call analysis output, keyed by field name.

type.description: Expected type for this call analysis field.

prompt_content.description: Inline prompt content — auto-creates an internal prompt for the agent

prompt.description: Reference to an existing prompt (alternative to prompt_content)

first_message_prompt.description: Agent's greeting message shown when chat starts

widget_config.description: Widget configuration for chat interface customization

AgentUpdate.description: All fields are optional — only provided fields will be updated.

parameters.name: conversation_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier (UUID format) of the conversation to retrieve

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Filter conversations created on or after this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: Filter conversations created on or after this date (ISO 8601)

parameters.name: from_time
parameters.description: Filter by time of day - start time (HH:MM format)

parameters.description: Filter by time of day - end time (HH:MM format)

parameters.name: timezone_offset
parameters.description: Timezone offset in minutes from UTC (default: 330 for IST)

Retrieve complete details and messages for a specific chat session

Retrieve normalized dynamic variable definitions for a specific agent.

post.description: Create a new prompt or a new version of an existing prompt. If a prompt with the same name exists, a new version is auto-created with an incremented version number.

value.prompt_content: You are a helpful customer support agent. Be polite and professional.

400.description: Bad request - Missing or invalid parameters

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of prompts. Returns the latest version of each prompt by default.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in prompt name and content

get.description: Retrieve a specific prompt by name. Returns the latest version by default, or a specific version if the version query parameter is provided.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Specific version to retrieve (omit for latest)

patch.description: Update a prompt by creating a new version. The version number is automatically incremented.

value.prompt_content: You are an expert customer support agent with 10 years of experience. Always be empathetic and solution-oriented.

400.description: Bad request - Missing or invalid parameters

delete.description: Permanently delete all versions of a prompt. Cannot delete a prompt currently used by any agent.

get.description: Retrieve all versions of a specific prompt, sorted by version number (descending).

post.description: Create a new AI agent with complete configuration including STT, LLM, TTS, prompt, call analysis configuration, tools, and widget settings. Supports two modes for prompt: inline prompt_content (auto-creates internal prompt) or reference to an existing prompt by name.

value.prompt_content: You are a helpful customer support agent.

call_analysis_prompt.custom_prompt: Analyze the call outcome, customer sentiment, and follow-up actions.

value.first_message_prompt: Hello! How can I help you today?

400.description: Bad request - Missing or invalid parameters

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all agents owned by the API key holder. Supports filtering by type, category, and search.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in agent name and description

get.description: Retrieve complete agent configuration by ID, including all STT/LLM/TTS settings, prompt, tools, and widget config.

patch.description: Update an existing agent. Only provided fields will be updated. If prompt_content is provided, creates a new version of the agent's internal prompt. If call_analysis_prompt.custom_prompt is provided, a new version of the analysis prompt is created before the agent is updated.

value.prompt_content: You are an updated customer support agent.

call_analysis_prompt.custom_prompt: Return the summary, customer intent, and next best action.

delete.description: Permanently delete an agent and its associated internal prompt.

get.description: Get all available STT, LLM, and TTS providers with their supported models. Use this to understand available options when configuring agents.

parameters.description: Filter by language code (e.g., en, hi, es)
